result:
The evidence is clear. The vulnerability is in `frag6_print()` in `print-frag6.c`. The function only bounds-checks `dp->ip6f_offlg` (2 bytes at offset 2 of the struct) but then accesses `dp->ip6f_ident` (4 bytes at offset 4) without any bounds check. A truncated packet containing exactly 4 bytes of fragment header passes the check but triggers a 4-byte over-read on `ip6f_ident`.

A truncated packet with exactly 4 bytes of fragment header data (enough for ip6f_nxt + ip6f_reserved + ip6f_offlg) passes the ND_TCHECK check at offset 2 but causes a 4-byte out-of-bounds read at offset 4 when EXTRACT_32BITS(&dp->ip6f_ident) is evaluated.",
